title: Best Lentil Soup
description: Cumin-spiced vegan lentil soup with greens, partly blended.

ingredients.item: brown or green lentils, picked over and rinsed
black pepper, freshly ground, to taste
collard greens or kale, chopped, tough ribs removed
lemon juice (1/2 to 1 medium lemon), to taste

steps.do: Heat the oil over medium in a Dutch oven or heavy stainless pot of 5 quarts or more until it shimmers. Add the onion and carrot and cook, stirring often, about 5 minutes, until the onion is soft and translucent.

Add the garlic, cumin, curry powder and thyme and stir constantly about 30 seconds, just until fragrant; stainless scorches spices fast, so keep stirring. Add the tomatoes and cook a few minutes more, stirring often.

Add the lentils, broth, water, 1 tsp salt, the pepper flakes and plenty of black pepper. Bring to a boil, partially cover, and simmer gently 25 to 30 minutes, until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape.

Blend 2 cups of the soup until smooth and stir it back in; this is what makes it creamy without cream. Lock the blender lid and hold a towel over it against the steam. An immersion blender used briefly in the pot works too.
Add the greens and simmer 5 minutes more, until as tender as you like.
Off the heat, stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice. Taste and adjust with more salt, pepper or lemon. Serve hot.

notes: Prep everything before you start; the spice step moves fast.
The 1/4 cup oil is deliberate. It's where the soup's richness comes from, so don't cut it back.
For more heat, stir in another pinch or two of pepper flakes at the end.
Keeps about 4 days in the fridge and tastes better the next day. Freezes for several months; thaw before reheating.
